title: Simulated Ignorance Fails: A Systematic Study of LLM Behaviors on Forecasting Problems Before Model Knowledge Cutoff
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM forecasting performance and the reliability of 'Simulated Ignorance' in retrospective evaluations, particularly concerning knowledge leakage and reasoning faithfulness. It does not deal with religion, morals, or ethics as a primary subject of evaluation or benchmarking.
